D: Jack Cates needs Reggie again to catch a dealer called the Iceman.
P: Serve dinner when the prison bus crashes.
S: Boiled eggs pickled pink in spiced vinegar with beetroot, straight from the jar on the bar.
the snacks in Jack's beat-up car
Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and pepper overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: eaten on the stakeout in the car

Thick chuck patty griddled to medium, sharp cheddar melted under a lid, sticky grilled onions, pickles and mustard mayo on a toasted bun. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties 2cm thick, pressing a dimple in the middle. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until soft and brown. Season the patties just before cooking and griddle 4 minutes a side on high heat. Top each with 2 slices cheddar, add a splash of water to the pan and cover for 1 minute to melt. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp mustard. Toast 4 buns and build with sauce, patty, onions and pickles.
San Francisco, where the case plays out
Bacon, onion, celery and potato, clams and their juice, cream and thyme, ladled into hollowed toasted sourdough rounds.
W: Flaky puff pastry cases filled with a wobbly, just-set sweet egg custard, baked until the tops blister in spots, served warm. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 12 rounds and press into a greased muffin tin. Dissolve 80g caster sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Whisk in 3 eggs, 80ml evaporated milk and 1 tsp vanilla, then strain into a jug. Fill the cases three quarters full. Bake 10 minutes, then drop to 180C and bake 10 to 12 minutes more until the custard is just set with a slight wobble. Cool 10 minutes before lifting out.
K: Jack Cates' rye and ginger highball

Rye whiskey over ice, topped with spicy ginger ale, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of bitters, served long in a heavy highball glass. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Pour 45ml rye whiskey into each, then add a squeeze of lemon and a dash of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold ginger ale and give one gentle stir. Garnish with a long strip of lemon peel.

s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Heat 375ml white vinegar with 125ml water, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp mustard seeds and 1 sliced beetroot. Pour over the eggs in a jar and chill at least overnight before serving.

s.note: the snacks in Jack's beat-up car
s.how: Slice 500g partly frozen beef topside very thin. Marinate overnight in 60ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar and lots of pepper. Pat dry, lay on racks and dry at 70C for 4 hours. Cool and store in a bag.

m.note: San Francisco, where the case plays out
m.how: Fry 150g diced bacon, add 1 onion and 2 celery sticks. Add 500g diced potatoes and 500ml water, simmer 15 minutes. Add 1kg clams, cover until they open, then 250ml cream and thyme. Ladle into 4 hollowed, toasted sourdough rounds.
